description: Step-by-step install of the user’s avatar into a website, with ready code for React (ania-avatar-react), Vue, Svelte, Angular, plain HTML or WordPress (Web Component), its movements and voice, a signed .ania download link (with curl) and the licence note. In IDE clients (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code…) apply it directly to the project. Free.

avatarId.description: Avatar id from meus_avatares or a finished job.

framework.description: The site framework (check package.json in an IDE).

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.
